aggregation: equal frames within take, equal takes within object, equal objects
cross_fitting: outer leave-one-object-out evaluation; inner leave-one-object-out selector-residual calibration

deployment_artifact.selection_rule: choose the in-support force-reachable candidate with minimum candidate UCB; accept only when candidate UCB plus nested selector correction is below zero

maximin.selection_rule: maximize the worst training-object relative improvement, then the training-object mean

mean.selection_rule: maximize training-object mean, then worst-object improvement
